pinceau.infobulle: Paint panel edges with an edge banding reference: one click applies it, a second click removes it. The edges are stored in the file and can be shown in colour.
tableau.infobulle: Lengths per edge banding reference, with cutting allowance, a small sketch per part and a CSV export for Excel.
surbrillance.infobulle: Shows or hides banded edges in colour on screen, without changing the design.
retirer.infobulle: Gives banded edges back their original appearance. The edge banding itself is kept.
dialogue.reference_infobulle: Reference applied to the next edges you click.
dialogue.chants_infobulle: Click a panel edge to band it; click it again to remove it. Only edges light up.
dialogue.tous_infobulle: Bands every edge of the visible panels, except edges touching another part.
dialogue.mode_infobulle: Colour on the faces: visible everywhere, saved in the file (may show on drawings). None: use Highlight Edge Banding when needed.
dialogue.ref_ep_infobulle: Edge banding thickness, used for the cut sizes.
dialogue.ref_couleur_infobulle: Colour used to show this edge banding in Fusion (a marker, not the real colour).
pinceau.disparus: {n} banded edges have disappeared since the last time (part modified). See the edge banding list.
pinceau.tous_resultat: +{n} edges · {x} touching another part left out
erreur.marquage: This edge cannot be banded (external or locked component?).
erreur.marquage_n: {n} edges could not be banded (external or locked component?). Nothing was changed. Details in journal.log.
erreur.apparence: No appearance found to colour the edges. Use display colour “None”.
tableau.disparus: {n} banded edges have disappeared (part modified): check them
tableau.note_marge: Lengths with allowance: + {m} mm per edge.
tableau.aucun: No banded edge in this design.
dialogue.marge_infobulle: Length added to each edge for the overhang at both ends (20 mm each end = 40 mm).
dialogue.debit_infobulle: Adds the cut sizes: the modelled size minus the banding thickness on each banded side.
